metadata.change_reason: API contract and communication interface quality standard: Strict backward compatibility, idempotency for mutating verbs, and unified error codes

spec.name: API Contract & Communication Protocol Quality Standard

rules.statement: Backward compatibility is an iron law: introducing breaking API changes without an established deprecation lifecycle is strictly prohibited (breaking_changes_allowed must be false)
All mutating write endpoints (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) must define an explicit idempotency mechanism
Must provide a globally unified business error code taxonomy with explicit HTTP status code mappings
